grammar.summary: 本课叙述泰坦尼克号沉没，集中运用 not only...but (also) 并列结构、even if 让步状语从句，以及 so...that 结果状语从句；同时大量使用被动语态描述「被发现、被进水、被弃船」的客观过程，并用过去完成时交代先于沉没的动作。

points.title: not only...but (also) 并列 (not only...but...)
points.explanation: not only...but (also)... 连接两个并列成分，表示「不仅……而且……」，also 可省略。本课用 not only the largest ship...but was regarded as unsinkable 强调泰坦尼克号「不仅是最大的船，而且被认为不会沉」。

examples.en: she was not only the largest ship that had ever been built, but was regarded as unsinkable, for she had sixteen watertight compartments.
examples.cn: 当时，这艘轮船不仅是造船史上建造的最大的一艘船，而且也被认为是不会沉没的。因为船由16个密封舱组成。

points.title: even if 让步状语从句 (Concession with even if)
points.explanation: even if = even though，引导让步状语从句，意为「即使、哪怕」，表示退一步的假设。本课用 Even if two of these were flooded, she would still be able to float 说明「即使有两个舱进水，船仍能漂浮」，突出设计的安全性。

examples.en: Even if two of these were flooded, she would still be able to float.
examples.cn: 即使有两个舱进水，仍可漂浮的水面上。

points.title: so...that 结果状语从句 (Result clause with so...that)
points.explanation: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句，表示「如此……以至于……」，that 引导结果状语从句。本课用 The noise had been so faint that no one thought that the ship had been damaged 说明「声音非常轻，以至于没人想到船已损坏」。

examples.en: The noise had been so faint that no one though that the ship had been damaged.
examples.cn: 由于这个声音非常轻，没人会想到船身已遭损坏。

exercises.q: she was not only the largest ship that had ever been built, ______ was regarded as unsinkable.
______ two of these were flooded, she would still be able to float.
The noise had been ______ faint that no one though that the ship had been damaged.
用被动语态填空：huge iceberg was suddenly ______ (spot) by a lookout.（写出 spot 的正确形式）
